decisions.reason: It fits the firm's core wafer and packaging capabilities and is likely retained as a niche custom offering despite limited visible market evidence after launch.
Carrier wafers are very close to the firm's established business and future direction in thin-wafer handling, so management would likely continue offering them.
As a flagship technology in advanced packaging that builds directly on the firm's materials and process know-how, it is strategically important to keep.
An off-the-shelf glass and quartz wafer brand strengthens the core product line and broadens commercialization of standard products, making discontinuation unlikely.

Glass-based circuit boards are relatively distant from the firm's core substrate business, so a focused German specialty manufacturer would be likely to redeploy resources away from this line if traction is uncertain.
